batches.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a square 1536x1536 production source sheet containing EXACTLY NINE separate inventory icons in a strict 3 by 3 equal grid, no gutters. Each 512x512 cell is an independent full square icon. Reference images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Match their painterly realistic fantasy-industrial equipment illustration, physically credible scratched metal and leather, warm gold directional key light, cool blue rim, crisp silhouette on subtly textured nearly black charcoal. Each object centered entirely inside its own cell, with 12 percent safe margins, three-quarter view. No text, letters, labels, borders, UI, stat glyphs, people, or scenery. Do not combine neighboring objects. Readable at 48px. Simple components modest; advanced equipment more elaborate. Cell 1, row 1 column 1: warforged_grip — heavy reinforced iron fist gauntlet with copper knuckle reinforcements.
Cell 2, row 1 column 2: titansteel_grip — massive dark titansteel fist gauntlet, double layered angular knuckles, strongest physical component.
Cell 3, row 1 column 3: marchplate — simple thick riveted steel defensive armor plate.
Cell 4, row 2 column 1: shatterdeep_crystal — single faceted violet crystal in a minimal iron socket, anti-magic component.
Cell 5, row 2 column 2: picket_plating — broad industrial steel breastplate with crimson padded inset and heavy rivets.
Cell 6, row 2 column 3: canyonward — protective canyon-crossing cuirass, weathered leather and violet crystal iron reinforcement.
Cell 7, row 3 column 1: breaker_aegis — angular layered iron shield with violet crystal and small teal timing coil.
Cell 8, row 3 column 2: resonant_wardstone — paired violet crystals fused into one stone in a heavy iron anti-magic cage.
Cell 9, row 3 column 3: foundation_plate — dense overlapping ancient iron defensive plates, bridge-foundation construction.
